item.title: Man dies after fire at home in West Jordan
item.description: A man is dead after his house caught fire in West Jordan early Thursday morning, a fire chief said.

item.title: Trump says he’s replacing Homeland Security Secretary Noem with GOP Sen. Markwayne Mullin
item.description: President Donald Trump said he's replacing his Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem.

item.title: More than 20 states sue over new global tariffs Trump imposed after his stinging Supreme Court loss
item.description: Some two dozen states are challenging President Donald Trump's new global tariffs in court.

item.title: Stocks drop after oil spikes to its highest price since the summer of 2024
item.description: Stocks sank on Wall Street Thursday after the price of oil spiked to its highest level since the summer of 2024 because of the war with Iran.

item.title: Iowa man who killed 3 Utah women said ‘it had to be done,’ charges say
item.description: An Iowa man who shot and killed three Utah women at random without warning in central Utah had no prior connection to his victims and no ties to the area, but claimed it "had to be done" to steal their cars, according to prosecutors.

item.title: Utah mother turns grief into mission to support veterans through Bowden’s Brigade
item.description: A Utah mother who lost her son after his military service is turning that grief into a mission to make sure other veterans don’t face the transition home alone.

item.title: Beaver police are still searching for man suspected of violent crimes
item.description: Late on March 4, 2026 a Beaver neighborhood was asked to either evacuate or shelter in place after a man was seen fleeing into a house.

item.title: Idaho couple stuck in Dubai, amid conflict in Middle East
item.description: An Idaho couple is trying to get out of Dubai after being stranded due to the war in Iran.

item.title: Kevin Franke said Ruby Franke, Jodi Hildebrandt ‘would be thrilled’ after Utah child welfare bill fails
item.description: Kevin Franke said Utah lawmakers missed an opportunity to better protect children after they rejected a child welfare bill he said could have helped investigators intervene sooner in abuse cases.

item.title: Wayne County communities remember, honor 3 women police said were killed by a stranger
item.description: Neighbors placed ribbons around communities from Loa to Torrey Thursday as they honored and remembered three women who investigators said died at the hands of a stranger.
